branch_policy: main/master only; documented historical_origin branch supplies a lineage slot before its recorded handoff date when the current repository has no snapshot; first-parent commits only; never use HEAD or side branches
source: existing full local Git clones; the three newly added repositories and the SimpliJs predecessor were cloned on 2026-10-24; no fetch performed by the generators
limitations: the registered repository list is fixed across snapshots; a repository contributes zero before its verified repository or documented historical-origin creation date
absence of a selected commit does not establish that the underlying project did not yet exist
if a repository existed by a cutoff but has no selected main/master commit, its historical size is unknown; totals and percentages are lower-bound reconstructions
snapshot selection uses Git commit timestamps, which are not independent archival timestamps
individual repository growth percentages are not calculated when that repository has no baseline snapshot
line counts are physical/nonblank lines, not language-aware SLOC
Git tree sizes count each repository copy separately

historical_origin.handoff_basis: first first-parent commit in virteal/SimpliWiki current history; README identifies JeanHuguesRobert/simpli as the engine powering it

creation_metadata_basis: GitHub repository creation dates; documented predecessor dates for lignée slots; metadata and source URLs are in the registry
commit_metadata_verification: selected snapshot commit SHAs and Git timestamps checked through GitHub commit metadata or their full local Git histories on 2026-10-24

commit_lineage_verification.method: GitHub compare API for previously measured current-repository snapshots; full local Git ancestry checks for newly added snapshots and documented predecessor handoffs
commit_lineage_verification.result: current repository snapshots are first-parent ancestors of the selected main/master tips; snapshots from predecessor repositories are attributed to their verified predecessor branch
